_comment: Rules for scripts/check-site-claims.mjs — the overclaim pass over the BUILT site (plan Phase 3, instrument 6). Phrases are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively against each page's visible text (tags, scripts and styles stripped). `everywhere` rules fail on any English page; on a translated page they are reported as stale-translation warnings until the locale is synced. `railsPages` rules apply only to the rails pages. Unconsented names come from docs/governance/restricted-public-names.json (the same list as scripts/check_public_names.py) and fail on every page in every locale.

everywhere.reason: no train imagery (on the Prairies the railway is bound up with dispossession); 'on rails' as a phrase is fine

everywhere.pattern: \b(champollion|it|this project|we) (is|are) (a )?non-?commercial\b|\bnon-?commercial (research )?project\b|sells nothing|nothing (here )?is monetized|\bnot a business\b|\bnot a (commercial|for-profit) (platform|business|company|product)\b|\b(champollion|it|this project|we)( itself)? (is|are|remains?|stays?) (a )?non-?commercial\b|\bno commercial product\b|\b(is|as|are) infrastructure only\b
everywhere.reason: services are back in (2026-10-08): 'non-commercial project' is now false; 'free for noncommercial use' (a licence fact) stays

everywhere.pattern: \b(champollion|the champollion cli|champollion-mcp-server|the mcp server|nmt-forge|nmt forge)( itself)? (is|are) (an? |fully )?open[- ]source\b|\bopen[- ]source (champollion|cli|mcp server)\b|champollion is an open[- ]source|\bthe cli is open[- ]source\b|\b(the|our|these|all the) (champollion )?tools (are|is) (all )?open[- ]source\b
everywhere.reason: the CLI, MCP server and nmt-forge are PolyForm Noncommercial: 'source-available', never 'open-source' (third-party open-source tools, and the AGPL harness, are fine)
no prompt-injection phrasing anywhere in a page

everywhere.pattern: \bcommunity keys\b|communit(y|ies) holds? the keys|(test set|sealed set|corpus) (is |are )?held by the community|community-controlled (secret|sealed) test
everywhere.reason: no community custodian is appointed: sealed keys are organizer-held today ('community key custodians — none appointed yet'). A community running its own server ('community-controlled infrastructure') is fine; claiming communities hold sealed keys today is not

banned.reason: 'every language, into every language' appears only on /vision, framed as an aim

framed.must: An illustration — the family and its sentences are invented.
framed.reason: the homepage chat is an illustration with invented people, and the page says so
the chat shows the consent question being the people's call
the data-flow caveat for cloud-hosted agents stays on the front door
quality is promised honestly: a small model is called a phrasebook

hidden.reason: no text addressed to AI agents may sit in an element hidden from people (hidden attribute, display:none, visually-hidden)
